def count_even_runs(s, i, run_len, to_print):
    if i >= len(s):
        return to_print
    if i + 1 < len(s) and s[i] == s[i + 1]:
        return count_even_runs(s, i + 1, run_len + 1, to_print)
    else:
        if run_len % 2 == 0:
            to_print += 1
        return count_even_runs(s, i + 1, 1, to_print)

def main():
    s = input().strip()
    result = count_even_runs(s, 0, 1, 0)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
